Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] Governor [[Kristi Noem]] defeated [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] nominee [[Jamie Smith (politician)|Jamie Smith]] to win a second term.{{cite news |last1=Mueller |first1=Julia |title=Noem wins reelection in South Dakota governor's race |url=https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/3723455-noem-wins-reelection-in-south-dakota-governors-race/ |access-date=8 November 2022 |work=[[The Hill (newspaper)|The Hill]] |date=8 November 2022}} Despite speculation about this race potentially being competitive, Noem improved on her [[2018 South Dakota gubernatorial election|2018]] performance by 11 percentage points and won 17 counties that she lost in 2018.
